title: DIAL SDLC Agent Manifest
description: Manifest at agents/<name>/agent.yml. The matcher validates every manifest against this schema at discovery time; violations fail the dispatcher loudly. Accepts the framework's v0.1 fields (some recorded-only today; see PLATFORM_REFERENCE.md for which are runtime-honored).

contract_version.description: Manifest schema version. Matcher rejects unrecognized versions.

name.description: Kebab-case agent name. Surfaces in PR comments, artifacts, kill-switch var name.

skill.description: Local skill the agent wraps. Must be addressable as `/<skill>` in a Claude prompt (e.g. `code-review-and-quality`, `opsx:verify`). Skill-only: no per-agent prompt.md is permitted; the composite action composes a uniform prompt that delegates work to this skill. Reusable agent logic belongs in `.claude/skills/` or `.claude/commands/`, not inlined in agents/.

agent_version.description: Semver-ish; recorded into the output envelope.

version.description: Framework's `version` field (alias of agent_version). Recorded but not used by the matcher.

source.description: Pin info for adopted/forked agents (origin/url/sha). Recorded only.

vetting_report.description: Path to vet-agent report. Recorded only; not validated.

paths.description: Path globs. NOT YET HONORED by matcher (v0.3).

branches.description: Target branches (e.g. PR base). Honored by matcher.

labels.description: Required labels (all must be present). Honored by matcher.

allowed_tools.description: Comma-separated Claude tool allowlist (passed to claude-code-action via --allowed-tools).

needs.description: Upstream agents this one depends on. Topologically sorted into rounds by the matcher (cap 3).

context_tier.description: A=triggering repo only (default). B=sibling repos via additional checkout. C=context bundle. Only A is implemented today.

sibling_repos.description: For tier B. Reserved; not yet wired.

permissions.description: GHA permissions the runner job needs. Matcher validates against platform-supported set; fails loudly if exceeded.

secrets.description: Declared secret names to inject into the agent's job env. run-agent.yml promotes ONLY these from the inherited secret bag (toJSON(secrets)) into $GITHUB_ENV before invoking the agent, and fails loudly if a declared secret is absent. The wrapped skill reads them via committed helper scripts — the model never types secret values (the agent-wrapper forbids shell expansion in Bash tool calls). ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is always passed and need not be declared.

tools.description: MCP servers and extra CLI tools available to the runner. `extra` items are installed by run-agent.yml before invoking the agent. `mcp` is recorded; not yet wired.

extra.description: CLI tools to install on the runner before invocation. See AGENT_REFERENCE.md → CLI dependencies for the three valid shapes.

oneOf.description: npm package name; latest stable. Installed via `npm install -g <name>`. Use the object form to pin a version.

name.description: For npm: the package name. For shell: a display name used in logs.

version.description: For npm: appended as `@<version>` to the install command (default: latest stable). For shell: available as `{{version}}` placeholder inside `install`.

install.description: Shell command to install the tool. When present, overrides the npm path. May reference `{{version}}` for substitution from the sibling `version` field.

action_ref.description: Pinned action ref (org/action@sha). Recorded only; the platform always uses its composite action for native agents. Specialized third-party-action workflows are written as standalone stage-<name>.yml files; see stage-security-review.yml.

model.description: Claude model. Empty uses action default.
Top-level shortcut for invocation.model. Either is accepted; top-level takes precedence.

timeout_minutes.description: Per-agent timeout. Honored by run-agent.yml. Default 15.

max_turns.description: Max Claude turns for this agent. Honored by run-agent.yml -> composite action. Default 18. Lower it for simple agents — fewer turns means fewer context resends, which cuts input-tokens-per-minute (rate-limit pressure).

concurrency.description: Concurrency group override. If omitted, platform derives `${workflow}-${name}-${ref}` with cancel-in-progress.

outputs.description: Declared output channels. Recorded; today the platform always emits pr-comment + artifact.

correlation_id_env.description: Recorded; the run_id envelope field is the canonical correlation ID.

kill_switch_var.description: Override the derived STAGE_{NAME_UPPER}_ENABLED var name.
